about: The arguments the nine tools of the June 2026 install advertised in tools/list (advertised: api-go/cmd/xmustard-mcp/main.go at 1a4ec87, whose lean and full lists were the same), and calls that use every one of them with a value of its type. TestOldInstallArgumentsStillAccepted makes each call and fails when an argument is rejected or its value does not reach the API: old agent prompts, skills and memories still send these names. A renamed argument keeps working through a hidden alias (recall and search query, now q). Never drop an entry to make the test pass.
